messages:
Sam: Hey all — thinking of doing a "Bring Your Own Controller" LAN night next Friday (6:30pm). Steam games + Switch party games. Who's in?
Evelyn: In! I can bring my laptop and a couple Steam keys (TowerFall, Gang Beasts).
Noah: Im down. Can we do a quick Steam sale wishlist swap so people can try games before buying?
Priya: Love that idea. Also I have two extra wired controllers and a long ethernet cable.
Sam: Poll: React :one: for Rocket League focus, :two: for indie arcade (Gang Beasts/TowerFall), :three: for free-for-all party night.
Evelyn: :two:
Noah: :one: then :three:
Priya: :three: flexible.
Sam: OK leaning party/indie. Logistics: bring chargers, controllers, and any HDMI adapters. Office rules — no alcohol and keep to common-room hours.
Noah: I can cover chips & soda. Any requests?
Evelyn: Can we have a gluten-free snack option?
Priya: I'll bring GF granola bars. Also can someone create a calendar event?
calendar-bot: Event created: "LAN Night - BYOC & Steam Swap" Friday 18:30 Office Common Room. Attendees: Sam, Evelyn, Noah, Priya.
Sam: Sweet. If anyone else wants to join, ping me and I'll add you to the invite. Also low-key tournament later if people want. :video_game:
